title: Nomad Public Web Command Requests
description: First Real User public Web/Gateway request DTOs: reply, deny, and stop. Responses use the separate CommandSubmission type. Historical internal commands are outside this public contract.

request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Same request_id MUST NOT produce more than one Host acceptance.

observed_seq.description: Client's currently observed durable sequence, used only as a freshness/CAS precondition. It does not allocate or predict a Host/durable sequence.
Client's currently observed durable sequence, used only as a freshness/CAS precondition. It does not allocate or predict a Host/durable sequence.

invariants.rule: observed_seq is only the client's freshness/CAS precondition and MUST equal the currently observed last_applied_seq. It MUST NOT allocate, predict, or claim a Host or durable event sequence.
Same request_id MUST NOT produce more than one HostAccepted. Duplicate request_id returns the stable prior result without re-triggering Host execution.
RelayReceived MUST NOT be interpreted as HostAccepted. Relay ACK means only that the Relay received the message, not that the Host acted on it.
Every command type MUST have a defined rejection result: Expired, Stale, Incompatible, or Revoked. Unknown-side-effect commands are explicitly prohibited from auto-retry.
OutcomeUnknown: when a writable tool's external side effect may have succeeded but the Host could not reliably record the result, the command status MUST be OutcomeUnknown. Auto-retry is FORBIDDEN.
deny MUST bind: permission_id, action_hash, expires_at, session_id and observed_seq. Missing or mismatched bindings return ERR_REQUEST_STALE, ERR_REQUEST_REVOKED, or ERR_SAFETY_BLOCKED.

state_machine.description: Command lifecycle state transitions. A command progresses through Client->Relay->Host->Result.

crash_window.description: Window between Host receiving the command and the result being durably recorded. During this window, the Host MUST mark the tool as OutcomeUnknown on restart and MUST NOT auto-retry.
crash_window.detection: On Host restart, scan for commands in HostAccepted or Executing state without a corresponding durable event. Mark as OutcomeUnknown.
crash_window.recovery: Surface OutcomeUnknown to the user. Do NOT automatically re-execute.
